text:
opsbot: ALERT: SLO burn-rate HIGH on /v1/generate (service: inference-api). burn_rate=3.4x over 5m, affected windows=[5m,15m]. Pager delivered to #eng-oncall.

lee_nguyen: grabbing traces — seeing a surge of retried requests + backend 504s. looks correlated with a spike in long-context jobs.

maria_gonzalez: any customer-facing errors reported by support? @samir_khan?

samir_khan: not seeing support tickets yet. telemetry shows a small fraction of requests getting >2x expected latency and hitting retry logic; queued on dedicated-pool-3.

lee_nguyen: stacktrace snippets: ```
2026-03-15T10:06:02Z inference-runtime ERROR request_id=abc123 kvcache miss, fallback to full forward
2026-03-15T10:06:04Z proxy WARN request_id=abc123 upstream timeout after 30s
```

lee_nguyen: hypothesis: sudden shift to longer prompts pushed KV cache eviction and increased per-token compute; batching collapsed and queueing increased.

julie_chen: ops question: do we page at 3x burn for 5m, or do we prefer multi-window evaluation? paging is noisy during traffic spikes.

dave_lawson: historically we page on 3x 5m to catch fast outages. but recent flareups are transient and noisy. suggested: require multi-window condition (3x 5m AND >2x 15m) or increase 5m threshold to 4x.

maria_gonzalez: customer-impact check: look at error budget consumption and any customer-affecting SLOs. if it's only budget burn with no 5xx, we can reduce paging.

samir_khan: current metrics: 5xx rate up from 0.02% -> 0.6% peak, mostly 504s. a handful of customers saw degraded completions. one notable customer had timeouts on streaming responses (~10 users).

lee_nguyen: mitigation plan: 1) divert some production traffic to burst-capacity pool, 2) temporarily loosen strict retry backoff to avoid thundering herd, 3) open an observability dashboard for deep-dive. executing 1) now.

opsbot: ACTION: routed 12% of traffic for model-143 -> dedicated-burst-1 (requested by lee_nguyen).

julie_chen: while diverting, we should avoid muting the alert permanently. propose: create a short-lived suppression rule that pauses paging for the 5m burn alert but keeps metrics for 15m/1h windows. anyone opposed?

dave_lawson: +1 to suppression with guardrails. set suppression for 15m, create a follow-up ticket to revisit thresholds.

maria_gonzalez: agree. but require that oncall posts a quick customer-impact summary in the ticket before suppression.

samir_khan: operational detail: here's the current prometheus query we use for burn: ```
sum(rate(error_budget_burn[5m])) / sum(rate(slo_budget[5m]))
``` propose we calculate a compound signal: burn_5m > 3x AND burn_15m > 1.5x to page.

lee_nguyen: good. also add a check for customers_with_failed_streams > 5 to trigger an immediate page regardless of burn windows.

julie_chen: I'll open the alert-tuning PR: change paging condition and add suppression toggle + runbook link. PR will include new query and example suppression policy (15m auto-expire).

opsbot: NOTE: incident created: INC-20260315-0784. linked to alert rule inference-api/slo-burn/5m.

lee_nguyen: quick debug: after divert, latency tail dropped ~30% and 504s falling. monitoring shows burn-rate decreasing on 5m but 15m still elevated.

maria_gonzalez: customers impacted: cust-omega had streaming errors — support notified and workaround (reduce concurrent streams) applied. no escalations.

samir_khan: putting an automated fallback route in place: if primary model exceed 200ms p99 kernel time, route to gpt-lite-variant. deploying canary now.

lee_nguyen: expectation: we'll allow suppression for 15m, but retain page-on-customer-impact flag. we should also add a dashboard tile showing "active suppressions" and "last time suppressed".

julie_chen: creating ticket INFOPS-4123: "Alert noise: refine SLO burn paging to multi-window + customer-impact gating". will include links to PR and dashboard mock. assignees: julie_chen, samir_khan.

dave_lawson: postmortem notes: we need to review batching heuristics and KV cache sizing for long contexts. add to eng-runtime sprint.

lee_nguyen: timeline/summary for ops channel: 10:06 alert -> 10:09 diversion started -> 10:18 5m burn subsided -> 10:24 created suppression (15m) + INFOPS-4123. current status: mitigated, monitoring for reoccurrence.

julie_chen: follow-ups: PR for alert query (ETA 2h), dashboard (ETA EOD), runtime perf story (sprint), post-incident review next week.

maria_gonzalez: +1. closing pager for now but keep incident open until PR merges.

opsbot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring. incident owner: lee_nguyen. follow-up ticket INFOPS-4123 created.

lee_nguyen: thanks all. I'll post the customer-impact blurb in the ticket and ping support owners.

samir_khan: small note for oncall handbook: add example suppression policy snippet and emphasize not to suppress without customer-impact check.

julie_chen: adding that to INFOPS-4123.

lee_nguyen: end thread.
